package_purpose: Credential-free source, frozen configuration, and expected archive hashes for a bounded ICT qualification worker.
archive_download: The VPS uses scripts/download_ict_market_archives.py to fetch only official Binance monthly 1m archives from 2023-12 through 2026-07 for NEARUSDT, LINKUSDT, APTUSDT, ADAUSDT. The source script verifies each published Binance checksum and ZIP contents.
